intent: Changed body width to 0.1m and sensor size to 0.016m to improve tracking performance.
learning: Hypothesizing that a narrower body and larger sensors will lead to better line tracking and reduced errors.
rationale: The previous race telemetry indicated that the robot's performance was hindered by a high line loss event count (5 events) and a significant RMS error (0.2). To address this, I am reducing the body width to 0.1m to improve maneuverability and increasing the sensor size to 0.016m to enhance detection capabilities. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events and improve overall tracking accuracy.
